newsitem.title: CANADA: Woman posing as photographer takes baby in Canada.
newsitem.headline: Woman posing as photographer takes baby in Canada.

text.p: A woman posing as a hospital photographer walked off with a newborn baby on Friday, British Columbia police said.
The alleged kidnapper asked a mother in the general hospital at Kelowna, a city in the agricultural interior of British Columbia, if she could take the baby outside to photograph him.
The mother agreed and the woman and infant disappeared, a police spokesman told reporters.
The police set up roadblocks to try to catch the bogus hotographer but by early evening the woman and child had not been found.
